root_cause.text: Missing of_node_put() after each successful of_parse_phandle_with_args() call in pcs_add_gpio_func() causes a reference count leak on the device_node obtained from gpiospec.np, as the loop never releases the reference.
root_cause.evidence: The patch description explicitly states that of_parse_phandle_with_args() increments the refcount in gpiospec.np and the loop never releases the reference, causing a refcount leak on each iteration. The patch adds of_node_put() calls both in the error path (devm_kzalloc failure) and after successful processing.

intent_record.how: This ensures that the device node reference obtained from gpiospec.np is properly released, preventing a reference count leak and resource pinning.
